d:
This gallery contains the surviving scans of the two Hideaki Anno interview sections published in SUN-MAGAZINE MOOK Shinseiki Evangelion JUNE Tokuhon: Zankoku na Tenshi no You ni (ISBN 4-906011-25-X).

The scans were recovered from a Wayback Machine copy of a Photobucket album originally shared by EvaGeeks member Ilari. The surviving material consists of the table of contents and pages 7–29.

Part 1 (pages 7–22) is complete. Part 2, the August 22, 1996 conversation with Nobi Nobita, begins on page 23 but is incomplete: pages 30–36 are currently missing.

Original EvaGeeks discussion:https://forum.evageeks.org/post/553271/Hideaki-Anno-JUNE-Interview-August-1996/
